guidance: Civil works are targeted for completion by Q2 FY27, en abling the release of fronts for mechanical and electrical installations.
This facility is targeted to be operational by Q2 FY28 and will act as a strategic distribution hub, helping us strengthen our presence and further expand our reach across the Gujarat mark et.
capex: Coming to Vadraj, I am pleased to share that we have inaugurated 2 million tons per annum of grinding capacity at Surat on 11th July 2026, ahead of schedule.
For our East operation, we continue to progress on our plan to add 4 million tons per annum of capacity in phases till FY28.
risks: The West Asia conflict, which drove up energy, pack ing bags, and other raw material prices, was not the only challenge during the quarter.
Net-net, we performed well in Q1 FY27 despite the macro headwinds.
focus: The performance reflects resilient execution, supported by contin uous focus on cost discipline and operational efficiencies.
As highlighted earlier, both Central and State Governments are targeting capex growth of around 20% and 15% respectively for FY27.
Of course, you'll have to do some trade schemes to get people working for us, but in general our positioning will be good, our premiumization will continue to be there, we'll focus on Microfiber.

about: Nuvoco Vista Corporation Ltd (NVCL) , is one of the largest cement companies and concrete manufacturers in India with a consolidated capacity of 25 MMTPA. It offers a diversified range of products such as cement, Ready-mix Concrete (RMX), and modern building materials i.e. adhesives, wall putty, dry plaster, cover blocks, and more. [1]
